content.title: About
content.content: Sweet potato fries, frozen are sliced batata strips that are blanched and flash‑frozen to preserve flavor, color, and nutrients. They are perfect for quick preparation in an oven or deep‑fryer.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Sweet potatoes are richer in beta‑carotene than regular potatoes, giving them a bright orange hue.
Freezing immediately after blanching locks in a crisp texture after cooking.
Sweet potatoes originate from tropical and subtropical regions but can be cultivated in cooler climates as well.
Compared with regular potatoes, sweet potatoes contain less starch and more dietary fiber.
Frozen products undergo strict quality controls to ensure safety and uniform portion sizes.

items.title: Rich in beta‑carotene
items.content: Beta‑carotene converts to vitamin A in the body, supporting vision and immune function.

items.title: Contains vitamin C
items.content: Vitamin C helps protect cells from oxidative stress and enhances iron absorption.

items.title: Source of dietary fiber
items.content: Fiber aids digestion and promotes a feeling of fullness.

items.title: Lower glycemic index
items.content: Sweet potatoes have a lower glycemic index than regular potatoes, helping maintain steadier blood sugar levels.

items.title: Provides potassium
items.content: Potassium supports fluid balance and normal heart function.

items.title: Sweet potato allergy
items.content: Rare, but some individuals may experience an allergic reaction to sweet potatoes.

items.title: Sodium content in prepared dishes
items.content: Adding salt or sauces can raise the sodium level of the final dish.

items.title: Caloric density
items.content: While nutritious, frying or baking with excess oil increases the calorie count.

items.title: Choking hazard for children
items.content: Small pieces can pose a choking risk for young children.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Bake at 200 °C for 12‑15 minutes or deep‑fry until golden. Serve as a side, in burgers, with dips, or as a healthy snack. Sprinkle with spices such as paprika, garlic, or rosemary for extra flavor.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the frozen product in a freezer at –18 °C or lower. After thawing, cook immediately and do not store at room temperature for more than 2 hours.
